verdict.rationale: Bench clearly supports connecting banking/card accounts via Plaid and pulls transactions automatically, and explicitly names payment/payroll tool integrations (Shopify, Stripe, Square, Gusto) flowing data in automatically. However, this is documented as feeding into Bench's own bookkeeping/reporting workspace rather than a customer-controlled 'ledger' the founder owns, and there's no evidence of direct payroll-system bank-level connections beyond Gusto mention or broader payroll provider support. Missing for 10: evidence of a broader payroll integration list beyond Gusto, confirmation these connections feed a true general ledger the founder can access/export at the transaction level, and independent/hands-on verification of the connection flow.
